meta.points_snapshot: MFM v1.1 (22 Jul 2026), audited 2026-07-27 against Wahapedia 11e, Tabletop Battles and Listhammer
meta.inventory_as_of: the quartermaster.md status column as of 2026-08-14 (the Bloodcrushers lot had not arrived)
meta.detachment: Shadow Legion (2 DP, Purge the Foe)
notes: Points marked derived were back-calculated from combined lines in the 07-27 ledger: Chaos Lord + Fade to Darkness = 120 and Bloodthirster + Fade = 350 give Fade = 30 and the Lord = 90; Fateskimmer + Leaping Shadows = 120 gives Leaping = 25; Bloodmaster + ten Bloodletters = 175 gives the Bloodmaster = 65; Skullmaster + Leaping + six Bloodcrushers = 290 gives the Skullmaster = 75. Verify each in the app before a tournament.
Unit sizes are listed only where the audit recorded a price. Most datasheets offer other sizes; read them from the app.
Wargear names and options are recorded as the datasheets stood when these lists were built. Anything the audit did not confirm carries a verify flag. The app is the arbiter.
Two Shadow Legion enhancements are recorded (Fade to Darkness, Leaping Shadows). The detachment's remaining enhancements were never captured in this repo; add them here when read from the app.
The Heretic Astartes cap is carried as the 07-27 ledger applied it: at most half the points, counted without enhancement costs. Verify whether the current wording counts points or units.

enhancements.name: Fade to Darkness
enhancements.source: derived: Bloodthirster + Fade 350 minus Bloodthirster 320 (07-27 ledger)
enhancements.gist: The bearer's unit, having destroyed an enemy unit in the Fight phase, leaves the battlefield into reserves and returns next turn. The yo-yo. Legal on any Shadow Legion Character that is not an Epic Hero, the Bloodthirster included (verified 07-27).

enhancements.name: Leaping Shadows
enhancements.source: derived: Fateskimmer + Leaping 120 minus Fateskimmer 95 (07-27 ledger)
enhancements.gist: The bearer's unit gains Scouts 9": a pre-game move, so a led brick or a monster threatens a turn-one charge.

enhancements.name: Soul-shattering Charge
enhancements.source: derived: Skullmaster + six Bloodcrushers + Soul-shattering Charge 275 minus 75 minus 190 (Battle Doctrine deck, tournament lists)
enhancements.gist: Not a Shadow Legion enhancement. Both 4-1 tournament lists took it by pairing a second detachment (Cavalcade of Chaos, 1 DP). Its rules were never captured in this repo, so no list in this book uses it; the validator rejects it.

units.name: Be'lakor
loadout: Blade of Shadows: strike or sweep
units.notes: Must be the Warlord when present (Supreme Commander). Epic Hero: no enhancement. Carries the 6" shadow bubble, the re-roll-1s-to-hit aura and the 9" terror aura; heals D3 when a nearby enemy unit fails Battle-shock.

units.name: Lord of Change
units.points_source: 07-27 audit (20 more than the seller's list)
options: Staff of Tzeentch may be swapped for a baleful sword

owned.built: check which melee weapon the painted model carries; every list assumes the staff

units.notes: Greater Daemon: a second 6" shadow bubble and terror source, and the army's only real shooting platform. Character, not Epic Hero, so it may carry an enhancement.

units.name: Bloodthirster
options: Great axe of Khorne may be swapped for the kit's other builds: an axe of Khorne with a lash of Khorne, or with a bloodflail. Read the exact swap wording and profiles from the datasheet. The great axe is the anti-tank build the tournament lists run (7 attacks, S16, AP-4, D6+2 as recorded 07-27).

owned.built: unassembled; build to the great axe if the kit's arms allow, and log which build you glue
owned.note: 3D-printed ABS resin kit on a 100mm base (a true Bloodthirster stands on a 120mm oval). Casual-legal; not a Citadel model, so banned at GW-run events. Re-base to 120mm and assemble with superglue.

units.notes: Character, not Epic Hero: Fade to Darkness is legal on it (verified 07-27). Drop, kill, Fade, Rapid Ingress back: off the board between swings.

units.name: Fateskimmer
units.long_name: Fateskimmer (Herald of Tzeentch on Burning Chariot)
loadout: Coruscating flames (ranged, the chariot's Blue Horror crew)
Lamprey bites (the Screamers drawing the chariot)
units.notes: Fast enough to drag the Tzeentch boon and a shadow's edge wherever the line is thin. Leads the Screamers; may carry an enhancement.

units.name: Exalted Flamer
loadout: Fire of Tzeentch: blue fire or pink fire profile (ranged)
units.verify_leads: The 07-27 ledger attached it to the Flamers; the Battle Doctrine deck attached it to the Pink Horrors instead. Verify which pairings the datasheet allows before relying on either.
units.notes: Mobile fire support under the Tzeentch boon. Parks near the Horrors and punishes whatever comes to clear them.

units.name: Flamers

owned.note: found in the 07-27 photo audit, unlisted by the seller

units.notes: Overwatch-grade fire that walks. Babysitters for the Horror line.

units.name: Pink Horrors
options: 1 model may carry a daemonic icon
1 model may carry an instrument of Chaos

owned.built: check whether the painted ten include an icon bearer or an instrument

units.notes: The congregation. Battleline, so Daemonic Manifestation returns up to D3 destroyed models per passed Battle-shock test inside the shadow. Split into Blue Horrors and then Brimstones as they die; the owned Blues and Brimstones are the tokens.

units.name: Blue Horrors
units.verify_options: Whether Blues take an icon or instrument, and whether the datasheet is Battleline, was not recorded. Verify.

owned.note: owned as the Pinks' split tokens

units.notes: Fielding the Blues as their own unit leaves no Blue models to split the Pinks into. Use the nine Brimstones as stand-ins for the split, or field one or the other.

units.name: Brimstone Horrors
units.points_source: split tokens only; no unit price recorded
units.notes: Kept in the inventory for the Horror split. Not fielded as a unit in any list.

units.name: Screamers
units.notes: Fast movement-phase damage for secondaries and rear objectives. Led by the Fateskimmer.

units.name: Nurglings
units.notes: Infiltrators with OC 0: they block, screen and start the midfield shadow economy on turn one; they do not hold ground. A second unit is the cheapest fill on every list.

units.name: Bloodmaster
units.points_source: derived: Bloodmaster + ten Bloodletters 175 minus Bloodletters 110 (07-27 ledger)

owned.note: one from the Jul 28 auction (delivered Aug 4), one from the Aug 13 Khorne lot

units.notes: Herald of Khorne on foot. Leads a Bloodletter brick; may carry an enhancement, and Leaping Shadows on a Bloodmaster scouts the whole brick.

units.name: Bloodletters
options: 1 model may carry a daemonic icon
1 model may carry an instrument of Chaos (the hornblower)

owned.built: the Aug 13 brick has a hornblower and an icon bearer; the Jul 28 brick: check
owned.note: nine from the Jul 28 auction (its 'ten' counted the Bloodmaster) plus eight to ten from the Aug 13 lot, whose count was never confirmed. Two full units need 20. The Jul 28 brick arrived shipping-damaged; repairs not yet logged.

units.notes: Battleline. Under the Khorne boon they Advance and still charge, so every turn alive they threaten roughly eighteen inches. Point them at whoever holds an objective.

units.name: Flesh Hounds
units.notes: Advance-and-charge cavalry for far objectives, backfield characters and screening the monsters' landing zones.

options: 1 model may carry a daemonic icon
1 model may carry an instrument of Chaos

owned.note: a lot of unknown count, 'some damaged', ETA Aug 18 to Sep 1 (reconfirmed Aug 11); not yet catalogued in this repo. Repair and re-base on arrival.

units.name: Chaos Lord
units.points_source: derived: Chaos Lord + Fade to Darkness 120 minus 30 (07-27 ledger)
options: Bolt pistol may be swapped for a plasma pistol
Exalted weapon may be swapped for a daemon hammer or a power fist (verify the current swap list)
units.verify_leads: Legionaries is the recorded pairing. Chosen is the other standard pairing for a foot Lord; verify. A Terminator-armour Lord leads only Terminators, which are not owned and not on the allowlist.

owned.built: the Blackstone Fortress Obsidius Mallex model: thunder hammer (play as daemon hammer) and plasma pistol. He runs on the generic Chaos Lord datasheet, so the Epic Hero ban does not apply.

units.notes: Gains Deep Strike in the detachment. Once per battle round his unit takes a stratagem free (as recorded): the return half of the yo-yo is a free Rapid Ingress.

units.name: Master of Possessions
units.verify_leads: Possessed is the recorded pairing. The CSM codex also lets him lead Legionaries or Chosen; verify before using either.
units.notes: Explicitly on the Thralls of the First Prince allowlist (verified 07-27). Buffs and protects the Possessed; gains Deep Strike in the detachment.

units.name: Possessed
units.notes: The deep-striking melee bomb. Arrives with the monsters; Warp Surge if the charge needs help.
